capability.name: Numeración legal
intents: asignar consecutivo interno a un borrador
asignar número legal al emitir un documento
resolver alcance y vigencia de una secuencia
explicar consumo hueco anulación o agotamiento
validar numeración por país entidad sucursal y punto de emisión

restrictions: internal and legal numbering have separate lifecycles
legal numbers are assigned only at issuance
consumed legal numbers are never reused or silently resequenced
legal allocation is serialized by the complete effective scope
country masks ranges resolutions and validity are versioned configuration
missing expired ambiguous or exhausted authorization fails closed
issued documents retain authorization and organizational provenance

deterministic: inspect sequence authorization scope and last allocation
detect gaps duplicates exhaustion and scope mismatch
poDecision: approve supported document types and markets
accept a new universal numbering primitive
approve migration or correction of production sequences
reviewerGate: concurrency and rollback preserve allocation invariants
same engine passes with at least two country configurations
scope includes tenant legal entity branch and point of issue as applicable
cancellation never releases a consumed legal number
missing or exhausted authorization fails closed
forbiddenWithoutApproval: provision or change a legal authorization
override or migrate last used number

retrieval.provenance: Legal Numbering capability derived from UBP ADR-0012 and implementation at pinned UBP revision ebf1c845bdf917d821f3182bff0cbe04c21d2c8e. Completeness claims remain blocked pending executable gapless, cancellation, Country Pack and scoped issuance evidence.
